purpose: rank the proteins of a phage genome by probability of being a holin
recipe: HistGradientBoosting over 36 handcrafted features + 480-d mean-pooled ESM-2 (t12_35M). TM-anchored local features were tested and rejected (scripts/15).

honest_performance_leave_one_genome_out.note: measured in scripts/22 by removing each genome's holin family before scoring it; this deployment model trains on everything, so these are the estimate, not its own score

known_limits: profile-match evidence: only 7 of 2,886 curated holins are Swiss-Prot reviewed
Pfam is exhausted as a source: 4,700 of 4,701 curated records joined existing families
P1 lydD remains the weakest annotated holin (0.60, rank 3/110)
precision falls vs the pre-curation model (0.75 vs 0.82 at >=0.9); use the 0.95 threshold for high-confidence calls
a genuinely novel holin family gets a shortlist, not an answer (strict AP 0.785)
usage: import pickle, features as F; m=pickle.load(open('models/holin_model_curated.pkl','rb')); X=hstack([handcrafted, esm.embed(seqs)]); m['model'].predict_proba(X)[:,1]
